\section*{Summary}

\subsection*{General Information}

```{r summary_general_info, echo = FALSE, results='asis'}
df1 <- data.frame(a = c("Case Name", "User", "Date", "KongohPlus version"), 
                  b = c("251006_test", "Sho Manabe", "2025-10-06", "0.21.6"))

df1_short <- df1 %>%
  mutate(b_display = ifelse(nchar(b) > 25, 
                            paste0(substr(b, 1, 10), "...", substr(b, nchar(b) - 9, nchar(b))),
                            b)) %>%
  dplyr::select(a, b = b_display)

k1 <- kable(
  df1_short, 
  format = "latex", 
  booktabs = TRUE, 
  row.names = FALSE, 
  col.names = NULL,
  escape = TRUE
) %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("HOLD_position"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
  column_spec(1, width = "4.8cm") %>%
  column_spec(2, width = "11cm")

k1
```

\subsection*{Deconvolution}

```{r summary_deconvo, echo = FALSE, results='asis'}

for(i in 1:length(hnc_all)){
  hnc <- hnc_all[i]
  data_hnc <- data_hnc_list[[i]]
  dt_param <- data_hnc$dt_param
  dt_log10like <- data_hnc$dt_log10like
  opt_list <- data_hnc$opt_list
  
  vec_temp <- rep(NA, 4)
  vec_temp[1:hnc] <- round(dt_param[["Estimated value"]][dt_param[["Parameter"]] == "Template amount"], 2)
  
  vec_mp <- rep(NA, 4)
  vec_mp[1:hnc] <- round(vec_temp[1:hnc] / sum(vec_temp[1:hnc]), 4)
  
  vec_deg <- rep(NA, 4)
  vec_deg[1:hnc] <- round(dt_param[["Estimated value"]][dt_param[["Parameter"]] == "Degradation"], 4)
  
  vec_temp[is.na(vec_temp)] <- "-"
  vec_mp[is.na(vec_mp)] <- "-"
  vec_deg[is.na(vec_deg)] <- "-"
  
  df_param_display <- as.data.frame(cbind(c("Template amount", "Mixture proportion", "Degradation"), rbind(vec_temp, vec_mp, vec_deg)))
  names(df_param_display) <- c("", "U1", "U2", "U3", "U4")
  
  
  vec_rep <- round(dt_param[["Estimated value"]][dt_param[["Parameter"]] == "Replicate amplification efficiency"], 2)
  df_rep_display <- data.frame(a = paste0("Replicate amplification efficiency ", 1:length(vec_rep)), 
                               b = vec_rep)
  
  num_attempt <- length(opt_list)
  if(length(opt_list) == 1){
    count_solution <- 1
  }else{
    current_score <- round(opt_list[[1]]$value, 3)
    count_solution <- 1
    for(i in 2:length(opt_list)){
      new_score <- round(opt_list[[i]]$value, 3)
      
      if(new_score < current_score){
        current_score <- new_score
        count_solution <- 1
      }else if(new_score == current_score){
        count_solution <- count_solution + 1
      }
    }
  }
  
  log10like <- as.character(round(dt_log10like[["Log10_Likelihood"]][dt_log10like[["Marker"]] == "Overall"], 2))
  num_attempt <- as.character(num_attempt)
  count_solution <- as.character(count_solution)
  
  df_convergence_display <- data.frame(a = c("log10(likelihood)", "No. MLE attempts", "No. acceptances"), 
                                       b = c(log10like, num_attempt, count_solution))
  
  cat(sprintf("\\subsubsection*{Number of contributors: %s}\n", hnc))
  
  print(
    kable(df_param_display, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, row.names = FALSE) %>%
      kable_styling(latex_options = c("HOLD_position"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
      column_spec(1, width = "4.8cm") %>%
      column_spec(2, width = "2.4cm") %>%
      column_spec(3, width = "2.4cm") %>%
      column_spec(4, width = "2.4cm") %>%
      column_spec(5, width = "2.4cm")
  )

  cat("\n\n") # space between tables
  
  cat(c("\\begin{table}[!htb]
    \\begin{minipage}[t]{.6\\linewidth}
      \\centering
      \\vspace{0pt}",
        kable(df_rep_display, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = NULL) %>%
          kable_styling(latex_options = c("HOLD_position"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
          column_spec(1, width = "6.6cm") %>%
          column_spec(2, width = "1.8cm"),
    "\\end{minipage}%
    \\begin{minipage}[t]{.4\\linewidth}
      \\centering
      \\vspace{0pt}",
        kable(df_convergence_display, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = NULL) %>%
          kable_styling(latex_options = c("HOLD_position"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
          column_spec(1, width = "4.4cm") %>%
          column_spec(2, width = "1.8cm"),
    "\\end{minipage} 
  \\end{table}"
  ))
  
  cat("\n\n") # space between tables
}
```
